facts.value: An eight-byte .sdata2 literal pool containing big-endian f32 values 0.0F and 1.0F. Both existing objects contain bytes 000000003f800000. The split object marks the section SHF_ALLOC; the source-built object marks it SHF_ALLOC|SHF_WRITE. The reviewed routines load these literals and do not write the pool.
facts.rationale: Qualify inherited read-only wording: literal use is load-only, but ELF flags differ between split and source objects. See data-corroboration.json for exact object hashes and flags.
